description: Fallback offline run for any query without its own recorded script: one search, then a cited answer.

content.text: I do not have a recorded script for this exact question, so I will search and answer from what comes back.

input.answer:
This run is offline, so the model turns and the search results are replayed from `fixtures/` rather than fetched live. The agent still executed the real loop: it planned, called the real `web_search` tool through the real registry, had its arguments validated, and returned this answer through the validated `finish` tool. To see a scripted end-to-end run with a fetched source and a calculation, ask "Why is the sky blue?" — that query has its own recorded fixture. [2]
